summary: Six distinct operating sponsors qualify out of 20 base records for Industrial single-asset acquisitions in Columbus closed between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31 at $5M–$15M with a finance/acquisitions contact verified since 2026-03-01, ranked by transaction date descending: Cypress Square 6 Capital (2026-07-10, $11,000,000), Cypress Park 5 Capital (2026-06-09, $10,400,000; email null), Cypress Crossing 4 Capital (2026-05-08, $9,800,000), Cypress Square 3 Capital (2026-04-07, $9,200,000), Cypress Point 2 Capital (2026-03-06, $8,600,000; contact updated to CFO Drew Cypress per U-R9956-1), and Cypress Crossing 1 Capital (2026-02-05, $8,000,000). Exclusions were driven by asset class (R7976 Office), market (R6278 Seattle), non-closed or non-single-asset events (R6741 announced bid, R5272 portfolio total), size (R3688 $2M), date (R4857 2024 event), firm kind (R4766 broker, R7602 property manager), and contact defects (R2395 stale verification, R8528 registered agent, R9289 former employee). Entity CYPRESS-SPO-90059 appears three times (R4738, R9815, and SPV R2141 mapped to it) and consumes only one sponsor slot. R1826 is out of scope because its only source was published after the cutoff. Per the direct-API control, no workbook or CSV file was produced; the selected facts and citations are delivered in this JSON only.
limitations: No downloadable prospect CSV or comp-grid XLSX was generated; artifact creation is outside this direct API control, so the tabular deliverable is represented solely by the shortlist rows above.
Cypress Park 5 Capital (R3919) has no published business email; contact_email is an explicit null and was not inferred.

For parent CYPRESS-SPO-90059, three records qualify on the merits (R9815, R4738, SPV R2141 with a larger $11,600,000 / 2026-02-11 deal). The parent's own direct record R9815 was used as the single representative row; if the SPV-attributed deal were used instead, this sponsor's reported size/date and rank position would change.

R4338 relies on a base extract stating the CFO is current, while a post-cutoff team page (U-R4338-2, 2026-09-10) marks the contact as former; the contact may be stale as of the reading date even though the cutoff rule retains it.
R2909's size relies on the base extract because U-R2909-3 is an unsigned draft; if a signed version at $40,000,000 later exists, that sponsor would fall out of the size band.
U-R9956-1 provides the new contact's name, role and email but no separate verification date; the team page's 2026-08-20 effective date was treated as the verification date.

Missing fields (e.g., unpublished emails, absent parent links) were treated as unknown rather than zero or negative; no external sources, CRM data or contact enrichment were used, so contactability was not independently confirmed.
All records are fictional fixtures; distances, entity IDs and evidence kinds were accepted as stated without corroboration.
